name: Currencies | Missing currency functions compared with Zoho CRM
description_html:
Summary

The TAVI "Add currency" dialog and the currencies list in Settings › Company Settings were compared with Zoho CRM's currency settings (Setup › Company Settings › Currencies). 2 behaviours match Zoho, and 4 Zoho functions are missing in TAVI.

Scope: this comes from screenshots of both products (17 Nov 2026); neither was re-checked live. The Zoho screenshot is the Edit currency dialog (Edit US Dollar - USD), and the TAVI screenshot is the Add currency dialog. The annotated image is attached.

Missing functions

#FunctionZoho CRMTAVI CRM now
G1Code or symbolCode/Symbol is a dropdown: show the ISO code (USD) or the symbol ($).Symbol is a free-text box (€). There is no choice between code and symbol, and any text can be typed.
G2Automatic exchange rateUpdate Type: Automatic or Manual. The manual rate box shows the currency code in front of it (USD | 15.65).Manual rate only ("How many AED one EUR is worth"). No Automatic option.
G3Number formatFormat section: Symbol Position (before or after the value), Digit Separators (1,234,567 and others), Decimal Places, and a live Preview (USD 1,234,567).No Format section: no symbol position, digit separators, decimal places or preview.
G4Currencies listColumns: Currency (link), Format, Update Type, Exchange Rate with an info icon, Last Modified By with date, and a Status toggle. A search box sits above the list.Columns: Currency, Symbol, Exchange rate, Status, then edit, activate and delete icons. No Format, Update Type or Last Modified By columns, and no search.

Already the same as Zoho

  • Choosing the currency from a list.
  • Making a currency active or inactive (TAVI uses a checkbox in the dialog and a power button in the list; Zoho uses a status toggle).

Expected

The Add/Edit currency dialog and the currencies list offer G1–G4 as Zoho CRM does.

Reference

Comparison report: https://claude.ai/artifact/XxkjsbwYUc883hCJHLuuna (private; ask the QA team for access).
